web.orders: a dedicated order-update socket (the realtime cn socket)

notes: The web streams Kotak over SFeed (native_batch) for every data centre; the legacy HSM client is kept only for a data centre whose feed config names it (kotak_adapter.py:135), which none does.
Depth is the five-level SFeed book whatever depth is asked for: subscribe ignores depth_level and _to_depth pads to five rows.
An index's Depth subscription is its index feed: a price over an empty book.
